dataset.name: google/fleurs
dataset.evaluationScope: ASR evaluation only; no human identity or biometric claim

eng.speakerDisjointSplitEvidence: FLEURS dataset card states train speakers differ from dev/test speakers.

hin.speakerDisjointSplitEvidence: FLEURS dataset card states train speakers differ from dev/test speakers.

npi.speakerDisjointSplitEvidence: FLEURS dataset card states train speakers differ from dev/test speakers.

selectionLimits.downloadPolicy: selected clips only; no split/archive download

metricProtocol.wer: word edit distance divided by reference word count; NFC, lowercase, trim/collapse whitespace; punctuation preserved
metricProtocol.cer: Unicode codepoint edit distance divided by reference codepoint count; NFC, lowercase; whitespace and punctuation preserved

selection.sourceMetadataObservation: Pinned-revision TSV rows provide row id, filename, transcript, normalized transcript, character form, num_samples, and gender; at 16 kHz, duration can be derived as num_samples/16000. They do not provide a speaker identifier or per-audio digest. The dataset-server first-rows endpoint returned HTTP 500/501 during preparation. Audio is stored in split-level tar.gz archives, so obtaining per-clip hashes requires selected audio extraction; no archive or audio was downloaded. No row is selected until exact clip digest and speaker identity/source reference can be recorded.
